messages:
Eve (Design): quick mock for the 'token cost' badge tooltip — want copy + a11y check
Eve (Design): Screenshot: [badge: $0.00012 / token] tooltip draft: "Estimated cost per token based on selected model and quantization settings."
Eve (Design): also thinking about aria-label: "Estimated cost per token: 0.00012 dollars."
Jamal (PM): short + clear is good. maybe drop the extra clause: "Estimated cost per token". keep the details in expanded popover.
Ravi (Engineering): FYI we compute a weighted average by sequence distribution. showing a precise cents value might be misleading.
Ravi (Engineering): suggest using approx symbol: "~$0.00012" or round to 2 significant digits: "$0.0001"
Claire (Accessibility): for screen readers please avoid putting the currency symbol before the number alone. prefer: "Estimated cost per token, approximately 0.00012 US dollars." Also mark the tooltip with role="tooltip" and ensure it is reachable via focus/hover.
Tom (Content): tone should be plain and functional. propose: "Approx. cost per token — $0.0001 (estimated)"
Eve (Design): hmm prefer not to use an em dash in the compact tooltip. proposed compact: "Approx. cost per token — estimated $0.0001" or "Approx. cost per token (est. $0.0001)". thoughts?
Jamal (PM): mobile/popover UX matters — in small view the tooltip becomes a popover with two lines. keep heading short.
Ravi (Engineering): confirm: mobile popover allows a title + detail body. we can include a smaller explanatory line: "Estimated using model, batch, and quantization."
Claire (Accessibility): two-line popover is fine, but make the first line announced as a heading via aria-describedby. avoid decorative punctuation like "—" for screen readers.
Tom (Content): alternate compact copy: "Approx. cost per token" (title) and body: "Estimated using your selected model and settings; values may vary."
Eve (Design): new proposal to implement in UI: Title: "Approx. cost per token" Body: "Estimated using your model and settings. Values may vary." ARIA label for the icon: "Approximate cost per token, estimated 0.00012 US dollars"
Ravi (Engineering): backend note: add a flag when estimate is older than 24h so UI can show "stale estimate" hint.
Jamal (PM): good call. can we show a tooltip footer: "Estimates update periodically"? keep it subtle.
Eve (Design): I'll add subtle footer in the popover: "Estimates update periodically" (smaller text)
Claire (Accessibility): for accessibility copy: recommend ARIA text: "Approx. cost per token. Estimated using your selected model and settings. Values may vary." That reads naturally.
Tom (Content): final copy proposal for designers/devs: Title: "Approx. cost per token" Body: "Estimated using your selected model and settings. Values may vary." Footer: "Estimates update periodically."
Eve (Design): ok I'll update the artboard and add the exact aria text for devs: "Tooltip: Heading: Approx. cost per token; Body: Estimated using your selected model and settings. Values may vary. Footer: Estimates update periodically."
Ravi (Engineering): noted, will implement aria label per Claire and add stale flag handling.
Jamal (PM): approved from PM side. thanks for consolidating. :thumbsup:
DesignBot: New Figma file linked: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234
Eve (Design): added PR #4123 with copy replacement and popover changes
Ravi (Engineering): saw the PR, will pick up tomorrow
Claire (Accessibility): reviewed the PR — a11y nit: use "US dollars" in aria label if you include currency words. otherwise fine.
Tom (Content): copy approved
Eve (Design): thanks team — closing thread.
